header.heading: A Galaxy of Cherished Memories
header.body: In our deepest cultural belief, those who depart do not disappear — they become stars in the night sky. Here, every farewell finds quiet reverence, shining forever in our collective memory.

footnote.body: Every star in this galaxy represents a life lived, a family held, and a memory kept alive with dignity.
footnote.concierge: Have a special remembrance request? Speak with our concierge

star-1.memory: A lifelong teacher whose quiet wisdom and warm patience shaped three generations.

star-2.memory: Her home was always open, her hands always giving, her silent blessing always felt.

star-3.memory: A guardian of duty, honour, and unshakeable grace through every trial of life.

star-4.memory: Dedicated fifty years to healing others with boundless empathy and humble devotion.

star-5.memory: Her laughter brought dawn into every room. An artist whose colors remain eternal.

star-6.memory: A pillar of selfless seva, gentle humor, and unwavering courage in every storm.

star-7.memory: Taught us that love is never measured in years, but in kindness given freely.

star-8.memory: A thinker who believed that knowledge is sacred when shared with humility and love.
